show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Dara Khosrowshahi - Uber's Bet on AVs, AI, and Building a Super-App - [Invest Like the Best, EP.476]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Dara Khosrowshahi, the CEO of Uber.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Dara Khosrowshahi, the CEO of Uber. Before Uber, Dara ran Expedia for thirteen years. We start with why he took this job in 2017, and a big part of that story is Daniel Ek.

key_points.text: We start with why he took this job in 2017, and a big part of that story is Daniel Ek.
We talk about what the chaos felt like on day one.
We spend most of our time on autonomous vehicles and Uber's role as the demand aggregator in a world of physical AI.
